field.name: Name
field.name.stripped: Hidden characters were removed from this name.
field.description.stripped: Hidden characters were removed from this description.
problem.name_missing: A new hook needs a name.
problem.name_long: The name is at most 80 bytes.
problem.name_bidi: The name holds a character that turns the direction of the text around it (marked below). Remove it to save.
problem.desc_missing: A new hook needs a description.
problem.desc_long: The description is at most 500 bytes.
problem.desc_bidi: The description holds a character that turns the direction of the text around it (marked below). Remove it to save.
refuse.unplaced: Its settings file is not known, so it cannot be changed here.
refuse.empty: A hook needs a command to be named.
refuse.long: A name this long cannot be sent whole.
refuse.ascii: The tool name has a character outside plain ASCII.
refuse.twin: The agent cannot tell it from another hook.
refuse.collision: Another hook in this file already has this command and tool. Nothing is sent.
refuse.ambiguous: The agent may take this for another hook in this file. Change the tool or the command more. Nothing is sent.
refuse.off: This hook is off, and a replacement would arrive on. Turn it on first, or delete it.
save.need: A field this hook needs is empty or wrong. Check the fields above first.
test.title: Run this command now?
test.saved: It can change files. Nothing is saved.
test.timedOut: It was stopped: it ran too long.
test.none: The agent ran nothing: no hook matched.
test.unknown: The answer was lost. The command may have run.
test.refused.approval_policy_unsatisfiab: Not available while this chat asks before every action.
test.refused.bad_request: The agent would not run it.
test.refused.not_found: The settings chat is gone. Close this and try again.
test.refused.other: The agent did not run it.
test.notrun: The settings chat could not be opened. Nothing ran.
ran.oldStays: The new hook was added. The old one is still there.
ran.unknownAdd: The new hook may have been added. Nothing else was sent.
ran.unknownRemove: The new hook was added. Removing the old one: outcome unknown.
refused.write_intent_invalid: The agent did not accept this request: its one-time permission had expired or been used. Nothing was changed. Try again.
refused.bad_request: The agent did not accept this change, so nothing was changed. Details says why.
refused.not_found: The agent could not find that hook, so nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_SCOPE: Pick one realm and a folder first. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_NOT_READY: The agent on this computer is not signed in as you yet. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_REFUSED: The agent would not open the settings chat. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_UNKNOWN: The settings chat may not have opened. Try again. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_BINDING: The settings chat opened somewhere other than expected and was closed. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_LEASE: The settings chat could not be kept open and was closed. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_LOST: The settings chat was lost twice. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_SUPERSEDED: You moved to another place before the chat opened. Nothing was changed.
ran.unknownSave: The change may have been saved. Nothing else was sent.
refuse.gone: This hook is no longer in the list. Close this and look at the list again. Nothing is sent.
remove.twin: The list now has another hook the agent could take for the old one, and a delete would remove both. Nothing was removed: delete the right one from the list.
remove.gone: The old hook is no longer in the list, so there was nothing to remove.
remove.unread: Not sent: the list could not be read again for this press, so nothing was removed. Try again.
remove.unsafe: The old hook cannot be removed from here now. Nothing was removed: look at the list.
refuse.when: This hook has a condition this page cannot show, so a replacement could not carry it. Nothing is sent.
refuse.when_event: This hook runs only when a condition holds, and only "When the agent finishes a turn" and "When a helper finishes" take one: keep one of those. Nothing is sent.
notsent.CAPABILITY_MISSING: This hook has a condition, and the agent on this computer does not support conditions, so the new hook would lose it. Update the agent. Nothing was changed.
